amendments: docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_PVP0_PVP_GAP_CLOSURE_CONTRACT_CANDIDATE_2026-10-10.md §6.1 (white skull after an unjustified kill; control plane D971)
control plane D1443 (rolling windows, exclusive end)
consumer: apps/game-server/src/combat/pvp/skull.rs (constants pinned by skull_tests.rs), evaluated in the victim's death transaction (apps/game-server/src/durability/pvp_state.rs)

evidence_classes.CIPSOFT_OFFICIAL: the official manual states the value
evidence_classes.OTS_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: the manual gives no exact value; the Canary/OTS value is used until a primary source is found
evidence_classes.OTERYN_DECISION: no reference value exists; the accepted contract row decides it (PARITY_PENDING)

windows.rule: Rolling windows of 24 h, 7 d and 30 d. Each unjustified point counts from its committed timestamp (database clock) while 0 <= now - committed_at < window: the window end is exclusive.
windows.source: tibia.com manual §combat 5.3.12, capture 2026-09-28 (docs/reference/tibia-manual/combat.md); endpoint: control plane D1443

red_thresholds_milli.source: Manual gives rule-of-thumb ranges 3-5 / 5-9 / 10-19 kills; the value is the lower bound, equal to Canary/crystalserver config as cited in docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_PVP0_PVP_GAP_CLOSURE_CONTRACT_CANDIDATE_2026-10-10.md §3 (dayKillsToRedSkull, weekKillsToRedSkull, monthKillsToRedSkull) 3 / 5 / 10 (x 1,000 milli per full kill)

black_thresholds_milli.source: Manual gives 6+ / 10+ / 20+; Canary uses twice the red thresholds

skull_duration_days.rule: skull_until = database clock + duration, reset by any new points; an unexpired skull is never lowered, shortened or cleared; it ends at skull_until (strict until > now).

kill_block_ms.rule: Every contributor (justified or not) gets kill_block_until >= database clock + 15 minutes, on every World type.
kill_block_ms.source: Manual: a kill sets a 15-minute logout and PZ-entry block (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_PVP0_PVP_GAP_CLOSURE_CONTRACT_CANDIDATE_2026-10-10.md §3)

white_skull_after_kill.rule: An unjustified contributor's white_skull_until is raised to at least its kill_block_until in the victim's death transaction (Open PvP only; a red or black skull shows instead).
white_skull_after_kill.source: Manual: the white skull lasts as long as the linked logout block; docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_PVP0_PVP_GAP_CLOSURE_CONTRACT_CANDIDATE_2026-10-10.md §6.1, control plane D971

points_milli.split: With more than 5 damage contributors each damage contributor gets floor(1,000 x 5 / n); assist-only contributors keep 500.
points_milli.source: Manual: a kill counts fully for at most 5 damage contributors and less beyond; Canary frag share 5 / N; the assist share has no reference value (PARTYPVP0-RL-19 PARITY_PENDING)

revenge_mark_days.rule: One mark per unjustified contributor (victim, killer, death); avenging belongs to PVP-DEATH-1.

point_retention_days.rule: The World job deletes point rows older than 45 days, expired revenge marks and ledger rows older than 5 minutes, and clears expired skulls, at most 100 rows of each kind per pass.
